correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed ALL 112 facets from the actual package verifier's exact list, computed every face and checked f=(12,66,220,390,336,112). Thus all 220 triangles are present, and exactly C(12,4)−390=105 four-sets are missing tetrahedra. No nonzero simplicial two-cycle fits fewer than four vertices, and on four vertices the two-cycle module is rank one generated by the tetrahedral boundary; a present tetra bounds. Independently checked that the frozen integer-valued triangle 2-cochain with 20 +1 and 15 −1 support terms evaluates to zero on every one of the 390 present tetrahedra and to ±1 on EVERY missing boundary (57 and 48). This exact integral cocycle proves each missing sphere is nonzero and primitive, with ambient H2=Z from the known S3×S2 topology. Independent incidence count gives all 12 vertices degree 35 in the 105 carrier blocks. The source verifier also computes mod-two boundary ranks 55 and 164, consistent with a 1-dimensional H2 over F2 but not substituted for integral primitivity.
correctness.risk: The integer cocycle, rather than mod-two ranks alone, establishes primitivity; cannot infer the same exact pattern for other triangulations.

value.rationale: This is an exact natural shortest-middle-homology carrier classification in a vertex-minimal five-manifold triangulation: every missing four-set, not just an unspecified example, is a primitive integral generator. This is an inclusion-sensitive topological property useful for locating compact homology witnesses and testing homological algorithms; the explicit cocycle makes it reusable without a large integral Smith-normal-form calculation. The family is narrow but specifically motivated, not an arbitrary slice.
value.risk: Narrow exact classification, albeit a natural extremal integral invariant of a vertex-minimal five-manifold complex.

final_claim: In Lutz’s exact twelve-vertex triangulation \((S^3\times S^2)^a_{12}\), the minimum vertex support of a nonzero integral \(H_2\) class is four, and all 105 missing tetrahedra, and only those four-sets, are minimum supports. Their alternating tetrahedral boundaries each represent a primitive generator \(\pm g\). The displayed cocycle gives 57 positive and 48 negative evaluations under fixed orientations; every vertex occurs in 35 minimal carriers.
limitations: Only the specific labelled Lutz (S3×S2)^a_12 triangulation; no claim for the other 12-vertex triangulations.
Only minimum vertex support in integral H2, not other homology degrees or geometric area.
The 57/48 sign split depends on fixed vertex labels/orientations and choice of cocycle; primitive classes do not.
